decision: Persistence recorded as the placeholder model choice.
reason: Only the persistence baseline existed. The split was fixed before any held-out scoring, after the 2026-10-09 vintage and the reconstructed vintage of 2026-10-10, so the 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-24 vintages and every later one were held out.

decision: Missingness offsets of the imputed share sampled non-centred.
reason: The centred offsets did not mix: R-hat 1.68 with a bulk ESS of 1.5 in a 2 x 200 fit.

decision: A late province is seeded over its first case week, not the week before.
reason: Seeding the week before put cases where the data have none.

decision: Primary scores use complete weeks only: weeks that ended at least K = 3 weeks before the truth vintage.
reason: By 21 days 96% of a week's final count is published in the delay data, so these weeks are close to final for every model.

decision: Every fit uses 2 chains of 500 warm-up and 500 draws, in the CI and the backtest.
reason: Sam's decision: one setting for all work, sized for the CI runners.

decision: The fallback variant is removed. The chain is renewal, its retry, renewalsp, persistencenow and persistence.
The publication lag default reverted to a fixed 0 to 3 days.
reason: The empirical lag counted onset backfill as late reporting, so it over-predicted.

decision: The held-out set rolls forward with each model choice, and the placeholder choice is removed.
reason: Sam's decision: models are tuned on all data up to each choice, and only vintages after a choice are held out.

decision: A BVDOutbreakSize release is used only if its joint R-hat is at most 1.1.
reason: Releases that had not converged would pass a poor Rt to renewalbvd.

decision: Health-zone forecasts split the province forecasts across zones.
reason: Against 2026-10-24 over the three earlier real vintages, zones split from persistence have WIS 0.83 and log WIS 0.88 times those of zone persistence, lower at every horizon from -2. Split from persistencenow the ratios are 0.93 and 0.90, lowest in the nowcast weeks and near one from horizon 0.

decision: persistencenow recorded as the first model choice, and held-out scoring covers persistence and persistencenow on every held-out vintage.
reason: persistencenow is submitted as seabbsbaseline. On complete weeks of the three real development origins its WIS is 0.69 times that of persistence. The baselines need no fit, so both are always scored beside the chosen model.

decision: persistencenow nowcasts every week, the latest included, scaling each published total by the share reported.
reason: Sam's decision. The share averages the delay cdf over onset days and a publication lag uniform on 0 to 3 days, as in the renewal model, which fits first reports on real data better than a fixed 3 days (29% reported at age 0 against 22% and 11%). On reconstructed vintages the latest week scores worse (WIS 172 against 47 for persistence) because they are built with a fixed 3-day lag; judged on real data, where it scores 22 against 41.

decision: persistencenow's reporting triangle is indexed by first publication.
reason: Nord-Kivu publishes batches late (246 rows for weeks up to 10-03 added between 10-17 and 10-24). Counting each delay to the first delay file holding the case lets the chain ladder and its retrospective sizes learn them, as baselinenowcast intends.

decision: Sparse places borrow the walk steps of places with their own delay, and below 10 cases a week walk a Poisson rate.
reason: Bas-Uele's own log steps from counts near zero gave 97.5% quantiles in the hundreds; pooled log steps from zero then collapsed to 1. The rate walk gives 3 to 5 a week for 7 cases in 6 weeks.

decision: persistencenow's walk takes steps from every nowcast week, with no 50% cut, and keeps the share-weighted centre.
reason: Issues #17 and #18. Steps from all weeks are not worse than the 50% rule (real as-of-T forecast-week WIS 18.9 against 18.0; reconstructed 83.4 against 85.5). An equal-weight centre (20.8 real, 92.9 reconstructed) and centring on the latest week alone (60.6 real) scored worse, so the latest week enters weighted by its share reported.

decision: persistencenow's publication lag gets a 10% tail spread over 4 to 28 days.
reason: Nowcasts of weeks 4 to 24 days old were biased low on every real and reconstructed origin (real national mean log ratio -0.11, Nord-Kivu -0.30). With the tail the real bias is -0.03 to -0.04 and nowcast-week WIS falls from 30.8 to 24.7, but forecast-week WIS on the 3 real origins rises from 21.4 to 28.1 (reconstructed 82.5 to 79.6).

decision: persistencenow keeps each place's own walk steps; a parent level can pass its pooled steps to places without delays.
reason: Shrinking each place's step spread toward a pooled spread scored worse at every strength (real as-of-T national forecast WIS 22.8 to 27.1 against 18.9).
